# Is a pass-through entity tax election worth it?

> Free calculator for S corporation and partnership owners: does a state pass-through entity tax (PTET) election save federal tax once the SALT cap, its income phase-out, your credit and the 20% pass-through deduction are counted? See the saving, why, and the income where it starts to pay. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
